bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 5, 6, 9, 10. PROPER TWELVE presents with scope to improve today. He was anything but disgraced at Tamworth when he stepped up to tackle this trip for the first time, last start. He will be race-fitter for 1600m today. JENNI LA ROCK had too much to do at Tamworth and her unplaced effort must be forgiven. SHARE OUR SECRET is yet to win a race anywhere but recent efforts in this, his first campaign since a stable change suggest that he should not be underestimated today. MEDIA SPIN was kept fresh before he opened his account here last start. He presents fresh again today and stepping up in distance can today aid his cause.

raceTips.comment: Hard race to assess. Media Spin has gone around as favourite in his past three runs and justified it with a last start win. Lightly raced with upside, he goes on top. Proper Twelve had his first crack over this trip last time out and will be much better for it. Share Our Secret is still a maiden but wasn't beaten far over this trip last time, though that race doesn't look to be an overly strong form reference. Sammaan City looks suited to the rise in distance.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 5, 9, 14. MI PLACE presents on debut after leading throughout in Mudgee and Bathurst trials either side of a spell. She is suitably placed in this class at her first run in a race. MAZORT caused his own problems first up at Narromine when he missed the start over only 800m. Stepping up to tackle this journey must be regarded as a plus with numerous gear changes made for today. KNIGHTS TEMPLAR is another debutant who should be treated with respect today. He presents at his home base and he's trialed twice since a spell. This journey should be ideal at start number one! FABULOUS ONE was spelled after there were excuses for an unplaced effort on debut at Ballarat on the synthetic surface. She resumes from her long spell today after a stable change and after winning her lead-up trial at Tamworth with Donovan Dillon aboard. She clearly has scope to return as an improved mare.

raceTips.comment: Mi Piace comes out so plan B. Mazort missed the kick when resuming but was strong to/through the line. Fitter/further are pluses. Fabulous One was pushed out and responded well to win a recent trial. Cooly Rocks resumes off a very long spell but sparks interest so has deservedly been kept safe in betting. Best Defence next.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 7, 9, 10, 12. PEERLESS SON handed in a solid performance when he was presented for the first time within this distance range last start at Gunnedah and he has scope to improve with that effort now behind him. SPICY SURPRISE begins his second preparation after a recent Muswellbrook trial and he did enough before his spell to be regarded as suitably placed in this class first up. KOJAK presents after a freshen-up and also after a stable change. He will soon appreciate further but even so, today at his new home base, he shouldn't be underestimated over only 1300m. MINERS MATE endured a tough run before he refused to shirk his task in defeat at Tamworth. He takes on in some cases older opposition as a three-year-old this afternoon, as he did at Tamworth and he is anything but out of place, making a Dubbo debut today.

raceTips.comment: Supergrace appeals at the price. Form around her since swapping regions has subsequently stacked up well, she offsets weight with a claimer again and is ideally drawn. Peerless Son finished in front of Supergrace last time out and it was a good effort, but the tables can be turned. Spicy Surprise was consistent in his initial prep in handy form reference races. Wide draw is the knock. Miners Mate next best.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 8, 11, 16, 17. MISS KARIS returns to her home base today. Her effort over this distance last start at Mudgee was full of merit and this race is within her reach. MRS BULL has maintained consistency (without winning) recently and she's another who returns to her home base today. The claim for Gabrielle Johnston aids her cause. TAKE THE CHANCE must be forgiven for an unplaced latest effort at Narromine when there were excuses! RUPESTRIS wasn't disgraced at Narromine when he was produced after a break of thirty days. This quicker back-up must be regarded as a plus when he now makes a Dubbo debut at his second start since a stable change.

raceTips.comment: Deodee closed off well last time out to finish within a length of the winner. From the draw there may be intent to settle closer in run which she has the tactical versatility to do. At the price, she appeals. Rupestris sets up as the map horse of the race and looks better suited over this longer trip. Mrs Bull had a tricky draw to overcome but offsets weight and is very race fit. Miss Karia next.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 5, 6, 10, 11, 15. PUFFIN was produced with a gear change made (visors on) when she was dominant over this distance at Gunnedah. She can already take the next step after opening her account so very stylishly last start. THE CONTRACTOR presents first up. He will soon appreciate a distance rise but today, fresh, this journey can suit. ORSUM has not been to the races for seventy-two days but he is stepping back in distance and he can be expected to find the line strongly as others begin to struggle. DENMAN FORCE must be forgiven for an unplaced effort at Narromine last start when there were excuses in stronger class.

raceTips.comment: Puffin impressed with a dominant win last start and profiles like the type who can continue on with things, particularly from the draw. Denman Force has a strong overall record and drops in class. Race To Arms always races well here and comes to hand quickly. Expecting he leads or near enough to so should receive every chance. Sorrento Palace next.

IT IS TO BE has been in work for some time but he gave no indication that he may be in need of a spell when he was produced at Wagga last start. GODWITS has only been produced once over this distance here at his home base. He scored with authority on the day in a race that produced strong form.

raceTips.comment: It Is To Be is a distance specialist who sets up for the map horse of the race and is hard-fit at this point. Lone Star Dream looks well placed dropping down in class. Another backmarker who will be doing best work late. Questionable next best.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 5, 7, 8, 11. CRUSADER KINGS resumes after a dominant lead-up trial performance at his Mudgee home base. He's been presented at Dubbo once and on the day, over this distance, he did look the part! CROOK did all but win here with Zoe Hunt aboard when she was presented in the same race that was last contested by WAVE BREAKER. She can be expected to maintain her form with Zoe retaining the ride today. WAVE BREAKER is a Scone based mare who was responsible for an honest effort here last start when she was produced after a forty-five day break. This quicker back-up can now be regarded as a plus. ZARIZATYCOON won his lead-up trial at Narromine late last month with Clayton Gallagher aboard and he's now more than ready to make a Dubbo debut first up with Clayton retaining the ride today.

raceTips.comment: Crusader Kings resumes on the back of a nice trial win and looks the clear horse to beat in this field which is reflective in the market. Crook is a consistent mare in this grading who has the early speed to offset a wider draw. Zarizatycoon has a strong winning strike rate. Wave Breaker looks the other key hope.

formRaceEntries.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward 3 Wide Settled Down Outside Leader .5 Lengths 800m 2nd .5 Lengths home turn 3rd Middle Of Track tired badly final 200m Stewards: Post race Vet check nasal discharge from both nostrils. Endoscopic exam is required # Vet/nasal discharge
formRaceEntries.commentStewards: When questioned, rider could not offer any explanation for the gelding's failure to close off in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to have nasal discharge from both nostrils. Trainer subsequently reported that a full veterinary examination including blood work an nasal scope revealed no abnormalities and that the gelding had pulled up well form the event. She could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance and advised the intention is to continue with the preparation. Veterinary clearance received.
